result.summary:
VERDICT PASS (review pass 2 of 3 of the loop after DESIGN-QA). No Critical, High, Medium or Low finding. Removing the dead JSON.stringify guard of answer() opens nothing: every field of a demo answer body is already forced to a string, a boolean or null before the body is built, so the body can always be written to text.

MAP OF SURFACES (change of this pass: git diff base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review4 base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review5 -- app .github, 7 files, 97 insertions, 72 deletions; the tag is HEAD 63e92a9, and app/ and .github are equal to it in the tree at the start and at the end). Comes from outside and goes to the browser: app/server/routes/demo.js (answer() removed; the two call sites return { status: 200, body } directly; the comment of text() says why the body is writable). Goes to the browser: app/public/css/site.css (one media-query edge 371 -> 379 px and its comment, CSS only), app/public/js/pages/demo.js (the result chips lose the title attribute; aria-label stays, set through setAttribute by el()). Tests, no surface in production (read for secrets, hosts, weakened checks): app/test/e2e/landing.test.js, app/test/int/demo.test.js (the DM-6c rows for an unwritable body are removed together with the guard they tested), app/test/unit/office-view.test.js (a comment layout), app/test/unit/vercel-build.test.js (a longer snapshot fixture). Writes files, holds a secret, the server goes by itself, customer data, photos: none touched; the diff of review4..review5 over app/server/http, app/vercel.json, package.json, package-lock.json, Dockerfile, .github, app/api, app/scripts, app/content, app/public/shared, app/public/js/office is empty (git diff --quiet exit 0), so headers.js (the CSP) and the workflow are untouched.

THE GUARD. Why it was dead: the body is built in the route; after the projection every id and text is a string (id() = text() throws demo_unavailable for any other type, texts() needs an array of strings), no_match_text is a string or null, lang is a constant from the language list, clear_leader is the engine's own boolean or null (a comparison result or true or null), and the engine's ranking, scores, rules and hypotheses never enter the body. A string cannot overflow JSON.stringify (a nesting limit applies to objects and arrays only); no field is an object, array of non-strings, bigint, symbol, accessor or toJSON holder. The one place where the body could still fail to be written is an intake string longer than the engine limit (about 512 MB); the intake is the repository's own file read once at start, not input of a visitor, and the visitor cannot put a value into the answer (the answers of a POST only select; the language is picked from a fixed list).

OWN ORACLES (my scripts, not the code's expression; run on a git archive of the tag in <scratch>/r5 and on a fresh clone <scratch>/r5clone). (1) ids.mjs of pass 1, unchanged: 19 slots x 41 shapes x 3 ways (createApp with the source languages, createEntry with the public languages, createEntry through the platform rewrite /api/index?__p=demo/...) x 6 lang values = 15 710 requests including the health checks: 0 answers 500, 0 violations (1 528 answers 200, 11 936 answers 503 with the exact stable body {"error":"demo_unavailable"}; every id, title, label, name, summary, no_match_text of a 200 is a string; no Kazakh letter in a 200 on the function paths); control landing and card-site answered 200. (2) NEW direct.mjs, the two handlers called directly so that a value that the app would write is judged without the app's catch: 37 slots (question id, title, option id and label, a whole question, options array, an option, solution id, name, summary, includes, not_suitable_when, a whole solution, the solutions array, needs_from_you, next_steps, price_text, rule points, when, solution, text, the rules array, result min_score, top, clear_lead_gap, no_match_text, the whole result object, hypotheses and their title, a root key, and two combined slots that force the no-match and the min_score -1e9 paths) x 30 values (strings incl. a 5 MB string, number, NaN, Infinity, -0, bigint, symbol, function, null, undefined, object, array, empty object and array, toJSON that throws, toJSON that returns a text, a getter that throws, a Proxy whose traps throw, a Proxy of an array, an array Proxy that throws on get, null-prototype object, class instance, String object, Date, Map, Buffer, an exact {ru,kk,en} text and a text-like object of objects, an own __proto__ key, and objects and arrays nested 1 000 and 20 000 deep) x 2 language sets x 5 lang values (ru, en, kk, xx, empty) x the matched and the cross answer set = 22 100 handler calls. Judged: a handler either throws HttpError (demo_unavailable or an engine refusal code) or returns a body whose every leaf, found by an iterative walk, is a string, a boolean or null, with plain Object or Array prototypes, no accessor and no symbol key, and JSON.stringify writes it. Result: 8 182 bodies 200 all passed, 13 918 refusals, 0 violations, 0 escapes, 0 stringify errors. Oracle control: on a mutant copy <scratch>/r5m with id: q.id, id: o.id and title: q.title (the projection removed) the same script found 483 violations (numbers, bigint, symbols, functions, undefined, odd prototypes), so it can see the failure it looks for. (3) depth scan, 8 slots x 100 depths from 100 to 20 000 x array and object = 1 600 requests through the function entry: 200 x 0, 503 x 1 600 (all with the stable body), 500 x 0, 0 log lines 500; the same scan on the mutant: 154 answers 200 with the Kazakh text and 10 answers 500, so the 20 000-deep window is real and is closed by the projection and not by the guard. (4) route fuzz, 2 900 requests through the function entry (all 900 valid answer sets x 3 languages, 26 hostile bodies x 7 lang values, 8 languages on the questionnaire, 10 methods): statuses 200, 400, 404, 413 only; 0 answers 500; 2 900 log lines, only the keys ts, level, req_id, route, status, ms, code, 0 log lines 500. (5) store and log probe, 300 requests with a marker in the query, the Cookie, Authorization, X-Mark and Accept-Language headers and the body, with fs write traps: 0 writes by the demo, 0 Set-Cookie, the marker is in none of the log lines, log keys ts, level, req_id, route, status, ms, code.

ITEMS. Q10 met: 15 710 + 22 100 + 1 600 + 2 900 + 300 requests gave 0 answers 500 and 0 log lines 500; every refusal is the stable 503 body; the app answers the next request (health checks in oracle 1). Q11 not applicable (the server calls no outside address; the change adds no fetch, and the only fetch of a page is still demo.js to its own two routes). R3 not applicable (decision 0033; headers.js unchanged, so the Permissions-Policy denies camera, microphone and geolocation as before). Q6 (not cheated): 0 skip, only, todo, eslint-disable, ts-ignore or '|| true' in the added lines; the removed DM-6c rows tested exactly the guard that is removed, and the projection rows of DM-6c (every non-string id and text, the deep values) stay and run; unit 120 of 120 and int 47 of 47.

THE OTHER EDITS. CSP unchanged (the diff of app/server/http is empty; script-src, connect-src 'self' etc. as in pass 1). The CSS edit is one media-query edge and its comment (no url(), @import, expression or content text added). The chips: the title attribute is removed and aria-label stays; the text still goes through setAttribute and textContent, no markup is built from a response text (grep of the added lines for innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval, new Function, cssText, srcdoc: 0 matches). The test edits touch no production file and add no outside host. The page still stores nothing new (no storage call in the diff).
